1	// Migration to remove MapStyleOp nodes and inline their value onto connected
2	// MaplibreBasemapOp inputs. The MapStyleOp was a pass-through node that only
3	// existed to expose a preset map style URL as a string output.
4	
5	import type { NoodlesProjectJSON } from '../utils/serialization'
6	
7	const CARTO_DARK = 'https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/gl/dark-matter-nolabels-gl-style/style.json'
8	
9	export async function up(project: NoodlesProjectJSON): Promise<NoodlesProjectJSON> {
10	  const mapStyleNodes = project.nodes.filter(n => n.type === 'MapStyleOp')
11	  if (mapStyleNodes.length === 0) return project
12	
13	  const mapStyleIds = new Set(mapStyleNodes.map(n => n.id))
14	
15	  // Build a map of mapStyleOpId -> the style URL value it held
16	  const styleValues = new Map<string, string>()
17	  for (const node of mapStyleNodes) {
18	    const val = (node.data?.inputs as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.mapStyle
19	    styleValues.set(node.id, typeof val === 'string' ? val : CARTO_DARK)
20	  }
21	
22	  // Find edges from MapStyleOp.out.mapStyle -> MaplibreBasemapOp.par.mapStyle
23	  // and record what value each target node should receive
24	  const targetValues = new Map<string, string>()
25	  for (const edge of project.edges) {
26	    if (mapStyleIds.has(edge.source) && edge.sourceHandle === 'out.mapStyle') {
27	      const styleUrl = styleValues.get(edge.source)
28	      if (styleUrl !== undefined) {
29	        targetValues.set(edge.target, styleUrl)
30	      }
31	    }
32	  }
33	
34	  // Apply values to target nodes and remove MapStyleOp nodes + their edges
35	  const nodes = project.nodes
36	    .filter(n => !mapStyleIds.has(n.id))
37	    .map(node => {
38	      const val = targetValues.get(node.id)
39	      if (val === undefined) return node
40	      return {
41	        ...node,
42	        data: {
43	          ...node.data,
44	          inputs: {
45	            ...(node.data?.inputs as Record<string, unknown> | undefined),
46	            mapStyle: val,
47	          },
48	        },
49	      }
50	    })
51	
52	  const edges = project.edges.filter(e => !mapStyleIds.has(e.source) && !mapStyleIds.has(e.target))
53	
54	  return { ...project, nodes, edges }
55	}
56	
57	export async function down(project: NoodlesProjectJSON): Promise<NoodlesProjectJSON> {
58	  // For each MaplibreBasemapOp with a mapStyle input value and no incoming edge
59	  // for par.mapStyle, recreate a MapStyleOp node and connecting edge
60	  const connectedTargets = new Set(
61	    project.edges.filter(e => e.targetHandle === 'par.mapStyle').map(e => e.target)
62	  )
63	
64	  const newNodes = [...project.nodes]
65	  const newEdges = [...project.edges]
66	
67	  for (const node of project.nodes) {
68	    if (node.type !== 'MaplibreBasemapOp') continue
69	    if (connectedTargets.has(node.id)) continue
70	
71	    const val = (node.data?.inputs as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.mapStyle
72	    if (typeof val !== 'string') continue
73	
74	    const mapStyleId = `${node.id}-map-style`
75	    newNodes.push({
76	      id: mapStyleId,
77	      type: 'MapStyleOp',
78	      position: { x: node.position.x - 320, y: node.position.y },
79	      data: { inputs: { mapStyle: val } },
80	    })
81	
82	    newEdges.push({
83	      id: `${mapStyleId}.out.mapStyle->${node.id}.par.mapStyle`,
84	      source: mapStyleId,
85	      target: node.id,
86	      sourceHandle: 'out.mapStyle',
87	      targetHandle: 'par.mapStyle',
88	    })
89	  }
90	
91	  // Remove mapStyle from MaplibreBasemapOp inputs where we just created a MapStyleOp
92	  const createdIds = new Set(newNodes.filter(n => n.type === 'MapStyleOp').map(n => n.id))
93	  const targetIds = new Set(newEdges.filter(e => createdIds.has(e.source)).map(e => e.target))
94	
95	  const nodes = newNodes.map(node => {
96	    if (!targetIds.has(node.id)) return node
97	    const { mapStyle: _, ...restInputs } = (node.data?.inputs as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {}
98	    return {
99	      ...node,
100	      data: { ...node.data, inputs: restInputs },
101	    }
102	  })
103	
104	  return { ...project, nodes, edges: newEdges }
105	}
